:::{#exm-chance-agreement}
#### Chance agreement for the COVID-19 test

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the chance agreement (@def-chance-agreement) is:

$$
\ba
p_e
&= \frac{786 \times 700 + 9{,}214 \times 9{,}300}{10{,}000^2}
&& \text{(definition of } p_e \text{, with the table's counts)} \\
&= \frac{550{,}200 + 85{,}690{,}200}{10{,}000^2}
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&= \frac{86{,}240{,}400}{10{,}000^2}
&& \text{(add)} \\
&= \frac{86{,}240{,}400}{100{,}000{,}000}
&& \text{(square)} \\
&= 0.862404
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-chance-agreement}

Because nearly everyone tests negative and is negative,
two independent classifiers with these margins
would agree on about 86% of people by chance alone.

:::
